verdict.rationale: Turso's docs describe point-in-time recovery that restores a database to a specific point in time, explicitly for recovering from user errors such as dropping a table by mistake. Separately, branching creates a new database from an existing one (`turso db create ... --from-db`). Together these cover the core of the story, but only through short first-party snippets. Missing for 10: retention-window length or limits, the PITR restore command or workflow (including whether it can restore into a new branch rather than in place), and independent or hands-on corroboration of recovery.
